title: From Dogwhistles to Bullhorns: Unveiling Coded Rhetoric with Language Models
reasoning: While the paper's taxonomy includes a 'religious' persona category for dogwhistles and mentions Evangelical Christian identity as an example, these represent a very small fraction of the study (4 out of 340 glossary entries). The core focus is on benchmarking the detection of coded rhetoric and social bias, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks themselves.
